description: Cleaned, typed, de-duplicated IoT telemetry (one row per device event). PII is hashed. Loaded by MERGE on event_id, so re-runs are idempotent.

schema.name: event_id
schema.description: Deterministic key: SHA-256 of device_id|event_ts. MERGE key.

schema.name: event_ts
schema.description: Event time in UTC (parsed from ISO-8601 or epoch-ms).

schema.name: imei_tac
schema.description: First 8 IMEI digits (Type Allocation Code): device model, not personal.

schema.name: imsi_hash
schema.description: Salted SHA-256 of the IMSI (subscriber identity).

schema.name: msisdn_hash
schema.description: Salted SHA-256 of the MSISDN (phone number).

schema.name: sinr_db
schema.description: Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio, dB (valid -20..30).

schema.name: firmware_version
schema.description: Semantic firmware version, without a leading 'v'.

schema.name: is_valid
schema.description: False when any data-quality rule failed (row is kept, not dropped).

schema.name: dq_flags
schema.description: Names of failed data-quality rules, e.g. rsrp_out_of_range.

schema.name: source_file
schema.description: gs:// URI of the raw file the row came from (lineage).

schema.name: ingested_at
schema.description: When the raw file landed in staging.

schema.name: processed_at
schema.description: When this row was last written to silver.
